title: Lunacy Calculator, various updates and fixes

texts: Added forced pair selection for Wedge Don and Sinclair in Team Builds, MD Plans (spec build), Daily Random Teams, Team Randomizer, and Team Solver.
Added a 'Mark all read' button on notifications so users don't need to click on each notification to mark them.
Fixed view counts being hidden from the creators of posts. The view counter was always working properly. The display was just showing a - instead of the actual number.
Reduced the clickable area for the Logout button and added a confirmation modal when clicking it to prevent accidental logouts.
Made a small clarificatory change to the description under the Discord integration section in Edit Profile.
Made some minor changes to the Support the site related texts.
